finding: Per-game box-score stat endpoints (/wnba/v1/stats, /box_scores, /season_stats) return 404 with the current API key/tier; only /games, /teams, /players are accessible. FGM and FTM are therefore NOT recoverable in this environment.
consequence: A fully-fitted STRUCTURAL POINTS decomposition (needs 2PM/FTM labels) remains blocked. Points uses the V5 minutes-mixture NB2 direct model (improved over V4), NOT labelled structural.
remedy: a BDL plan/tier exposing per-game box scores (or an alternate licensed box-score feed) is required; recovered_v2 stats (fga/fg3a/fta/fg3m/oreb/dreb) came from a source that included those splits but not fgm/ftm.
